generic_prompt: A first-person gameplay view in a retro 3D stone maze.
scheduler: UniPCMultistepScheduler from pinned VACE config, flow_shift 3.0, 30 steps
noisy_latent_construction: Use one torch.float32 CUDA standard-normal tensor drawn with generator seed 42; for each scheduler sigma, z_t=(1-sigma)*cached real target latent + sigma*same noise, then cast to transformer BF16. Reuse bit-identical z_t within each three-action comparison. This is a fixed forward-noised real trajectory, not a rollout.
transformer_branch: Conditional VACE transformer output with cached generic text embedding, cached native O0 control, control scale 1.0; no CFG combination or video decode
feature_precision: Load adapter checkpoint strictly, cast to BF16 exactly as M6B-1 inference, measure projected features in FP32
relative_conditioning_strength: L2 of action bias broadcast to all 16x28 spatial patches divided by L2 of frozen noisy patch-embedding output at the same temporal position, before addition
denoiser_relative_l2: L2(output_A-output_B) divided by mean of L2(output_A) and L2(output_B), symmetric in pair order; FP32 metrics
global_temporal_scope: Report all five latent positions and future-only positions 1..4; per-position metrics include 0..4
checkpoint_trajectory: At middle scheduler position, repeat feature statistics and three pairwise denoiser comparisons for checkpoints 100,200,400,800
interpretation: Exploratory A/B/C/D classification; no user-specified numeric cutoffs. Compare action-feature distinctness, broadcast bias/base ratio, pairwise denoiser effect relative to outputs, and M6B-1 failed semantic criteria; avoid new PASS/FAIL thresholds.
model_mutation_policy: No training, weight updates, mask change, new data, video generation, or dependency changes
